purpose: Make two questions checkable instead of remembered. First, does every claim marker in the foundation paper have a status and a backing record, and does every record it links exist. Second, does every finding the laboratory records have a home in a paper, or an explicit note saying it is post-preprint.
how_records_are_found: Not stored here. scripts/check_claim_bindings.py reads the paper and takes the links that follow each <!-- nsc-claim:ID --> marker. Storing them again would let this file and the paper disagree, and the checker would then be checking the copy rather than the paper.

status_values.proposal: the paper states a target or a proposal, not a completed result
status_values.external_reference: the claim is about published work the project cites and applies
status_values.derived: the project derived or computed the stated object
status_values.measured: a finite comparison in a named domain was carried out and recorded
status_values.open: the question is stated and not decided; an open result is not a failure
status_values.unspecified: status not yet assigned; the checker reports these as a count rather than failing

status_rule: By identifier prefix: target-* is a proposal, imported-* is an external reference, derived-* is derived. Anything else starts unspecified so that no status is invented.

findings.summary: Four reciprocal physical effects and a same-trajectory local reduction meet their one-percent comparison targets under one evolving metric and common action.

The enclosing and enclosed forces reach equality in all six cases, but the crossing moves instead of holding a radius, and a stronger exterior dissolves it. A sustained gradient bubble is not established.
Sampled local trapping character on the finite chart. Initial extrema marginal. Explicitly not a global horizon and not a child region.
Completed finite turnover on the frozen depth-three window. Geometry there is an input.

A static local leading-action solution changes its inner and outer proper lengths in opposite directions. A locked first-order forecast predicts the withheld changes with 0.018 and 0.793 percent remainders.
Retained, drive and memory columns reconstruct the field and its full common-action force, evolving their own geometry. Independent full evolution agrees at recorded numerical precision.
Nonperiodic horizon-regular PG exterior with a distinct areal-radius near-throat child. The numerical family is still described as running and its physical results are not claimed.

Characteristic coordinate speeds are 1-beta and -1-beta, about -1.1708 and -3.1708 at the throat, both toward the child even when the local normal-frame light direction is outward. The local speed stays one.
Regional eigenvalues are Lambda_n times the shared dimensionless spectrum; coherent nesting holds at arbitrary finite depth by the normalized recursion.

nonclaim: A binding and coverage audit of documents against records. It adds no scientific claim and does not assert that any finding listed here should enter a paper.
